[[File:Kotor2_vibrocutter.png|thumb|250px|A vibro-cutter.]]
A '''vibro-cutter''' was a heavy cutting implement that, much like a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], utilized an [[vibration cell]] to create ultrasonic vibrations enabling it to cut with the slightest touch. Although vibro-cutters were manufactured with industrial needs in mind, they were at times used as weapons. The [[Fastcutter]] was one common brand of vibro-cutter.

The tool was used for carving [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] rock, such as could be found at the [[Peragus Mining Facility]].<ref name="The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
